change_note: Copy v3: short (under ~80 words before the signature), opens on the partner's situation in conditional terms (never asserts a need), one sentence about BoRo with the nearshore difference (their hours, Spanish, documented code under their brand), an interest question addressed to the person (usted) or the team (ustedes), short signature. The subject carries the company; hook and subject depend on the signal's segment and the country's e-invoicing localization. Proof points describe BoRo's own code on boro-vps and are anonymized: no client names (acos/specs/somosboro-web-b2b-casos.md: no written consent to publish clients). The Odoo partner follow-up adds BoRo OS (BoRo's own platform on Odoo: HR, collections, inventory and sales), approved by Amaru on 2026-11-11. Amaru confirmed on 2026-11-11 that BoRo does e-invoicing localization (DTE, SUNAT, CFDI, DIAN). Rules, cadence and volume are unchanged. PENDING before activation: Amaru confirms version-migration work (named in the Odoo follow-up).
